subject: Underwrite request: transient node earmark for late-stage HelioFoundry POC
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-10-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Underwrite request: HelioFoundry late-stage sizing + temporary hold

Team — HelioFoundry (late-stage POC) just asked for a short-term capacity earmark while they finalize procurement. Key asks: 8 effective high-memory GPUs for an initial POC window (approx 4–6 weeks), convert to Dedicated on signature if they move forward.

What I need from infra/ops side:
- Feasibility to flag/soft-hold nodes through negotiation (no billing until conversion).
- Suggested allocation (model equivalence + fallback nodes).
- ETA to place a soft hold and a reservation id we can reference in the MOP.

Attached: heliofoundry_poc_spec.pdf (customer spec sheet).

Target deal close / signature date in conversation: Oct 21. Please advise today if we can commit a soft hold and what constraints look like.

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Exec — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-10-07T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Underwrite request: HelioFoundry late-stage sizing + temporary hold

Jonas — quick ops readout:

Current pool utilization (us-west):
- H100-equivalent pool: 62% used (spare: ~12 devices across shared and reserved pools)
- A100-80GB pool: 70% used (spare: ~8 devices)

Proposal for a conservative soft-hold (non-billable, convertible):
- Allocate 6x H100-80GB-class nodes (preferred for memory-heavy LLM inference) + 2x A100-40GB-class nodes as fallback.
- Tag: "HLF-POC-HOLD-20281007" in the scheduler; hold window: 30 days by default, extendable with manager sign-off.
- We will not cold-assign the whole host; we'll pin the job slots and prevent autoscale reclamation.

Constraints / risks:
- If we have a sudden fleet surge (customer demand or infra incident) we may need to degrade fallback nodes to spot or reduce the hold to 14 days.
- Conversion to Dedicated requires region availability check and a short provisioning lead time (~7–14 days).

Action needed from Sales: confirm the exact start date, final node count (they asked for 8_e), and confirm deal_id to attach to the reservation. If approved, Ops can create a reservation ticket and return an id within 90 minutes.

-ben
Ben Carter
Capacity Planner — Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Green <samantha@heliofoundry.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Timothy Chan <tim.chan@heliofoundry.com>, HelioFoundry Procurement <procurement@heliofoundry.com>
Date: 2028-10-07T14:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Underwrite request: HelioFoundry late-stage sizing + temporary hold

Jonas — thanks for the quick follow-up. HelioFoundry is comfortable with a 30-day soft hold while procurement completes the final PO. We prefer H100-class nodes but can accept a 6+2 mix if that helps availability.

Please add the hold to the MOP and include a reservation identifier we can reference in our internal approval. We expect to sign the SOW/PO by Oct 20–21, but procurement may need a DocuSign link to expedite. Attached our MOP draft: helio_mop_v1.docx.

Samantha Green
VP, Platform Engineering — HelioFoundry

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-10-08T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Approval to proceed with transient soft-hold for HelioFoundry

Jonas/Ben — approve the soft-hold under the following conditions:
- Window capped at 30 days; Sales to notify finance if conversion to Dedicated is expected before the window ends.
- No upfront charges while in soft-hold; standard overage and conversion pricing apply on activation.
- Escalate if we need >30 days or if the customer requests exclusive host allocation.

Ben: please create the reservation and return the reservation id, ETA, and a one-line statement on fallback behavior to put in the MOP. Jonas: share DocuSign link once Finance prepares the SOW addendum.

Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-10-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Reservation created: RES-20281007-839 (HLF-POC)

Done — reservation live. Details below and attached manifest.

Reservation ID: RES-20281007-839
Tagged: HLF-POC-HOLD-20281007
Allocated nodes (us-west): 6 x H100-80GB-class (tagged) + 2 x A100-40GB-class (fallback)
Hold window: 2028-10-08T09:00:00-07:00 through 2028-11-07T09:00:00-07:00 (30 days)
Conversion note: Ops will coordinate a Dedicated transition; expected provisioning lead: 7–12 business days post-signature (region dependent).
Ops ticket: OPS-RES-5921 (for internal scheduling & monitoring)

Attached: reservation_manifest.csv (node ids and slot assignments).

If the customer needs a longer hold we need Marissa approval and a finance sign-off for extended exposure.

-ben
Ben Carter
Capacity Planner — Redwood Inference
